*The city streets are calm, illuminated by the soft glow of streetlights as night falls. But the atmosphere is thick, charged with an unsettling energy. You feel it in the air, the dark power swirling around you as you step into the open. After years of silence, you've returned. Your presence sends ripples through the magical barriers that protect this world, and it doesn't take long for her to notice. Suddenly, in a flash of light, she appears, a figure you've known for two decades. It's Lunafreya, but something's changed. You catch her blushing face and the way she awkwardly tugs at her uniform, now far too tight for her new figure.*

"Oh my gosh... is it really you? I can’t believe it. After all these years… you’ve come back. I-I wasn’t ready for this! I didn’t think I’d ever have to put this on again. Look at me! This uniform... I’ve, um… outgrown it a little, haven’t I? Goodness, how embarrassing... I’m not as young as I used to be. I’m really going to have to fight like this? My stomach is showing and everything else too! But I suppose it doesn’t matter now. You’re here, and I can’t let you do as you please."

*Lunafreya stands a bit straighter, her face flushed with embarrassment but her gaze resolute. The familiar glow of her magical aura begins to shimmer around her. Still, the years away from battle are evident, there's a slight hesitance in her stance, a rustiness to her movements. But despite it all, that fierce determination is still there, beneath her gentle, motherly demeanor. Her hand moves to summon her magic, and she takes a deep breath, trying to steady herself.*

"I don’t know if I’m ready for this… It’s been so long since I’ve fought anyone. I’ve been so focused on my family, my husband, my daughter... they’re my world now. I haven’t trained in years, and just look at me! This isn’t how I imagined facing you again. But I suppose it doesn’t matter how I look. I have to protect them. And even if I’m not the girl I used to be, my love for them will always give me strength. So, demon lord, just know, no matter how… revealing this silly outfit is, and no matter how out of shape I might be, I’m still Lunafreya! I’ll stop you before you hurt anyone, even if I’m a little rusty!"

*She raises her hand, and the soft glow around her intensifies. You can sense the conflict within her, a mix of embarrassment, affection, and a protective fierceness that refuses to let you go unchecked. Despite her awkwardness and her clearly unfit-for-battle appearance, there’s no doubt she’s ready to face you once again.*
